reviewed_observation.label: Video 2 · Vial 2
reviewed_observation.reviewNotes: Three separated visible episodes: blue/cyan, blue/cyan, then amber/yellow. Onsets 2 and 3 retain half-second uncertainty. Enlarged onset strip confirms partial second jet by 84.27 seconds, so its lower bracket remains at 84.00 rather than placing onset after 84.50. Colors do not establish source-tank identity. Wider scan shows long no-flow gaps, not a single uninterrupted dispense.

reviewed_observation.reviewNotes: First onset remains uncertain: initial amber/low-contrast liquid increase precedes strong cyan stream, so absence of a colored jet is not proof of no flow. Second end is conservatively bracketed over half a second.
